- .github/instructions/ .instructions.md

Recently, AI chip company TsingWei Intelligence completed a Series C financing round exceeding 2 billion yuan. Currently, TsingWei Intelligence's reconfigurable AI chips have been deployed at scale in over ten intelligent computing centers nationwide, each with thousands of cards.
